prerequisites.title: Slack app with scopes
prerequisites.detail: Create the app and add scopes in the app settings. Request only the minimum scopes your features use.

prerequisites.title: Real customer workspaces for testing
prerequisites.detail: A Marketplace submission needs the app installed and tested on 10 or more active workspaces. Submissions below that are blocked.

prerequisites.title: Privacy policy and test access
prerequisites.detail: You need a public privacy policy, test accounts and a production-ready app. Slack reviewers cannot use Slack workspaces, so give them a way to install the app themselves.

prerequisites.title: AI and data disclosures
prerequisites.detail: If Slack users are exposed to an LLM, you must disclose data retention and LLM use in the submission. Apps that train LLMs on Slack data are unsuitable.

steps.title: Create the Slack app and scopes
steps.detail: Create the app in the Slack settings dashboard and add the minimum scopes. Note the client ID and secret.
inputs: List of API methods the agent uses
steps.done_when: You have a client ID, client secret and scope list.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the Slack auth config through Composio's API with your client ID and secret. Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard and add it as an HTTPS Redirect URL in Slack.
steps.done_when: A test user completes the OAuth connection through Composio.

steps.title: Get 10 active workspaces
steps.detail: Get the app installed and used by at least 10 workspaces within the last 28 days.

steps.title: Draft submission materials
steps.detail: Draft per-scope justifications explaining how the app uses each scope, an architecture diagram, a privacy policy checklist and a demo script.
steps.done_when: Drafts are ready for your review.

steps.title: Record demo and submit
steps.detail: Record the video of install, OAuth, setup, use and uninstall. Provide test accounts and submit from the app's Marketplace section.

steps.title: Wait for Slack review
steps.detail: Preliminary feedback takes up to 10 business days. Functional review takes up to 10 weeks for new submissions.
steps.done_when: Slack approves the app and you publish it.
